title: Keep implementation actors outside verifier decision authority
lane_outcome: Issue #2725 is satisfied generically and in the repository adapter: shared credentials or marker syntax cannot let an implementer occupy, suppress, satisfy, or fail an independent verifier decision cycle.
purpose_for_parent: Restores the protected reviewer boundary required before later enforcement and delegation claims can be trusted.
technical_strategy: Reuse the portable separation-of-duty projection and bind this repository's marker intake to provider-controlled producer-app metadata, never GitHub login, association, or caller-authored marker fields.
technology_choices: Treat REST performed_via_github_app metadata as the repo adapter's trusted producer identity.
Keep implementation status marker-free and preserve the existing exact-head review policy.
